{text:body}

North Lakes was built from the late 1990s around its lakes and the Westfield, and most of its roofs are concrete tile or Colorbond on homes 15 to 25 years old. Severe storms hit the area most summers, and hail causes a large share of our call-outs here. A cracked tile, a dented gutter or a lifted ridge cap lets water in during the next downpour, so we tarp quickly and supply the photos and written report your insurer will ask for. Mango Hill and Griffin have similar homes. Petrie and Kallangur have more older brick and timber houses, and their roofs are often ready for a restoration or a full re-roof. Out at Narangba the blocks are bigger, and people often ask us to look at the shed, carport or patio roof while we're up there. We quote those in the same visit, so you only need one inspection.
